data.content: At site-year-quarter resolution, what fraction of driver events (IS_DRIVER with is_driver = true) coincide with a detection of the same substance (median_concentration > 0 on MEASURED_AT) at the same site, year and quarter, and does this fraction differ by species?

args.query: Compute, at site-year-quarter resolution, the overall fraction of driver events where (Substance)-[d:IS_DRIVER {is_driver: true}]->(Site) coincides with a detection of the same substance ((Substance)-[m:MEASURED_AT]->(Site) with m.median_concentration > 0) at the same site, year and quarter. Also compute the same fraction broken down by species of the driver event. Return: total_driver_events, detected_driver_events, overall_fraction, and for each species: species, species_driver_events, species_detected_driver_events, species_fraction. Use the IS_DRIVER year and quarter to align with MEASURED_AT year and quarter.

            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (s:Substance)-[d:IS_DRIVER]->(l:Site)
WHERE d.is_driver = true
WITH DISTINCT s, l, d.year AS year, d.quarter AS quarter, d.species AS species
WITH s, l, year, quarter, species,
     EXISTS {
       MATCH (s)-[m:MEASURED_AT]->(l)
       WHERE m.year = year AND m.quarter = quarter AND m.median_concentration > 0
     } AS detected
WITH collect({species: species, detected: detected}) AS events
WITH events,
     size(events) AS total_driver_events,
     reduce(dc = 0, ev IN events | dc + CASE WHEN ev.detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detected_driver_events
WITH events, total_driver_events, detected_driver_events,
     CASE WHEN total_driver_events = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE toFloat(detected_driver_events)/toFloat(total_driver_events) END AS overall_fraction
UNWIND events AS ev
WITH total_driver_events, detected_driver_events, overall_fraction, ev.species AS species, ev.detected AS detected
RETURN
  total_driver_events,
  detected_driver_events,
  overall_fraction,
  species,
  count(*) AS species_driver_events,
  sum(CASE WHEN detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS species_detected_driver_events,
  CASE
    WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / toFloat(count(*))
  END AS species_fraction
ORDER BY species

            ```
